stage: input-preparation-only; independent admission pending; no dispatch
code_selection: Whole audited source files, plus same-version module declarations/type context needed to expose ancestor cfg and referenced driver configuration; exact list/ranges/hash frozen in inputs.json before packet generation
comments: All original ordinary comments, rustdoc and attributes retained identically in both arms. This is not a documentation-free baseline. External design/migration documents only in document arm.
entity_policy: IDs plus neutral actual source/type/method locations only; no behavior summaries, researcher owner recommendations, reasonable/unknown case classifications or evaluation fields from cards.json in model payloads
common_task: Behavior, applicable sourced specification, placement at type/module/crate or unknown, exceptions/distinctions, missing evidence and bounded next check; no requirement to move
historical_reports: Original documentation test counts are document statements only, not this batch's results; contradictions preserved verbatim
evaluation_only: audit cards, protocol evaluation ledger, prior/after/history, hashes and validation reports not dispatched
closure_limit: Complete selected files and explicit parent module declarations are not a complete dependency, macro, cfg, call-graph or runtime closure; no compilation/execution claim
revision_rule: Goodall blocker requires minimally corrected NEW run version, never modifying current audited originals
